table.name: TLGNR_DISTRIBUTION_DEST_BS
table.description: Distribution Destination characterizes the involved organisations and direction of an order: OUT/Outbound are orders which leave Crh (Crh to Customer), IUD/Interunit-Distribution are within Crh to distribute materials, IUP/Interunit-Production are within Crh and production relevant, INB/Inbound are orders from a supplier to Crh. The return types (xxxR) distribution destintions are needed for rail orders (return of the empty wagon), and a special type for repair orders (REP) exists as well.

column.name: DISTRIBUTION_DEST_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data, such as OUT, IUD, IUP, INB, REP, OUTR, IUDR, INBR.

column.name: SELECTABLE_FOR_SHIPTO_FLAG
column.description: Defines if the code can be selected in dispocard for the field tlgnc_shipto_sarea.distribution_dest_cd. (Reason: with LOGON EBM/2.0, this value is no longer received from SAP, but is manually maintained in LOGON directly). 1=selectable, 0=not selectable.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
